finishedText:
Visit date: 12/11. Present: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes, Bea.

A visit was conducted on 12/11 and was attended by Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea. It was observed that mould has returned in the back bedroom and is worse by the window. The landlord has not replied to two emails sent by them:Landlord. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline. The date of birth on the form is 3/3/87.

It was agreed that I:Worker will ring the landlord on Monday and Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on my:Worker list, offered to help with the form.

The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late.

The next step is to revisit 26/11.
